Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 set_block_property('VSSL_CNTNRS', UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_ITEM_property('TABALE_STA_CD', UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
END;
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('VSSL_CNTNRS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_DCLN_CNTR_TAPLE_GLOBALS.VSSL_CNTNRS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_DCLN_CNTR_TAPLE_GLOBALS.VSSL_CNTNRS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$LOV_DCLN_CNTR_TAPLE_GLOBALS.VSSL_CNTNRS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_TYPE');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_TYPE '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_TYPE '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_TYPE LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_TYPE ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((CNTNR_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT CNTNR_TYPE_CD '||'FROM CNTNR_TYPES WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VC_VM_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('لا يوجد مانفيست بهذا الرقم في هذا التاريخ', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VC_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('لا يوجد وكيل شحن بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VC_CT_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('لا يوجد نوع حاوية بهذا الرمز', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

/* CGFK$CHK_VSSL_CNTNRS_VC_VM_FK */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_VSSL_CNTNRS_VC_VM_FK(
 P_PORT_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_MFST_DT IN DATE /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT. */
 ,P_MFST_NBR IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR. */
 ,P_MFST_TYPE IN NUMBER) IS /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VSSL_MFSTS
 WHERE MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE
 AND (MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR OR
 (MFST_NBR IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_NBR IS NULL ))
 AND (MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT OR
 (MFST_DT IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_DT IS NULL ))
 AND PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

/* CGUV$CHK_SVCNTNR_UK */
PROCEDURE CGUV$CHK_SVCNTNR_UK(
 P_CNTNR_MRK IN VARCHAR2 /* Item value */
 ,P_CNTNR_SEQ IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ. */
 ,P_MFST_DT IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT. */
 ,P_MFST_NBR IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR. */
 ,P_MFST_TYPE IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE. */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_RECORD_STATUS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* The ROWID */
/* Check uniqueness against primary/unique constraint */
/* Note : NO_DATA_FOUND exception handled by calling trigger */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 IF (P_RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT') THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VSSL_CNTNRS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND (MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR OR
 (MFST_NBR IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_NBR IS NULL ))
 AND (MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT OR
 (MFST_DT IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_DT IS NULL ))
 AND (CNTNR_MRK = P_CNTNR_MRK OR
 (CNTNR_MRK IS NULL AND
 P_CNTNR_MRK IS NULL ))
 AND MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
 ELSE
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VSSL_CNTNRS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND (MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR OR
 (MFST_NBR IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_NBR IS NULL ))
 AND (MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT OR
 (MFST_DT IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_DT IS NULL ))
 AND (CNTNR_MRK = P_CNTNR_MRK OR
 (CNTNR_MRK IS NULL AND
 P_CNTNR_MRK IS NULL ))
 AND MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE
 AND P_PORT_CD != PORT_CD
 AND P_MFST_TYPE != MFST_TYPE
 AND P_MFST_NBR != MFST_NBR
 AND P_MFST_DT != MFST_DT
 AND P_CNTNR_SEQ != CNTNR_SEQ;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SVC_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك التسجيل,نوع المانفيست,رقم الم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVCNTNR_UK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('عفوا..سبق تسجيل نفس العلامة المميزة للحاوية على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CNTT_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز نوع الحاوية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_TAPALE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_TAPALE IS
 V_CNT_RECORD NUMBER ;
-- V_CNT_CHK NUMBER := 1;
BEGIN
 LAST_RECORD;
 V_CNT_RECORD := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP

 UPDATE VSSL_CNTNRS
 SET TABALE_STA_CD = :TABALE_STA_CD
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = :CNTNR_SEQ
 ;

 IF :TABALE_STA_CD = 1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(18,5,26,:PORT_CD||'!'||:MFST_TYPE||'!'||:MFST_NBR||'!'||:MFST_DT||'!'||:CNTNR_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :TABALE_STA_CD IS NULL THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(18,5,27,:PORT_CD||'!'||:MFST_TYPE||'!'||:MFST_NBR||'!'||:MFST_DT||'!'||:CNTNR_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :TABALE_STA_CD = 2 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(18,5,28,:PORT_CD||'!'||:MFST_TYPE||'!'||:MFST_NBR||'!'||:MFST_DT||'!'||:CNTNR_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD =V_CNT_RECORD ;
 NEXT_RECORD;

 END LOOP;
END;
